topic: how Amazon Web Services makes most of the profit of the whole of Amazon
storyAngle: Amazon looks like a giant shop but most of its profit comes from the cloud business in the back.
doNotClaim: Do not say Amazon retail loses money.
AWS sales are revenue, not profit: NEVER compare AWS sales with Amazon profit.

facts.claim: AWS OPERATING INCOME (profit) in 2024 was $39,834 million.
Amazon TOTAL OPERATING INCOME (profit, all segments) in 2024 was $68,593 million.
AWS NET SALES (revenue, not profit) in 2024 were $107,556 million.

derived.claim: AWS was about 58% of Amazon operating income (39,834 / 68,593): a bit over half of all the profit.
